name: Kanno Sayuri
source:
She is currently a first-year student at Fujisawa Gakuen. Due to a health issue during middle school, which resulted in a long hospital stay, she started school a year late. She is working hard to catch up on her studies.

[Edited from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010210230907/http://www.web-giga.com/seihin/win_fs/win_fs.htm]official website[/url]]
